name: selo
description: A Claude Code plugin to spec, plan, implement and review web applications (front, API, database) with a disciplined, reviewed workflow.

plugins.name: selo-flow
plugins.description: The workflow: /selo-flow:setup sets up the project, then blueprint, build, fastlane, pilot, grill and review run the spec → plan → code → review loop, driven by the project's selo.yaml manifest.

plugins.name: selo-feed
plugins.description: The ops export for Selo Ops, and the session recap: hooks only, no skill. Enabled once at user scope, it exports every session, in a selo project or not.
